cookie-policy/index.html: Cookie Policy Cookies and similar browser storage in the current unpublished website build. Local-preview observations must be rechecked on the final host. Internal draft — owner and legal review required. Draft revised 31 October 2026 . Not yet effective or approved for publication. Technical descriptions concern the current redesign; review notes identify unresolved business or legal wording. On this page What the current build uses Light and dark preference Your browser controls Third parties and launch review What the current build uses No website cookie-setting code, advertising or analytics integration is included. The inspected local preview had no JavaScript-visible cookies, session-storage entries, IndexedDB databases, Cache Storage entries or registered service workers. These are observations of that preview, not a guarantee about future hosting or external platforms. Light and dark preference Storage type: localStorage. Key: kanjay-theme. Values: light or dark. Purpose: remember the colour theme in this browser for this website origin. With JavaScript enabled, loading a /theme/light/ or /theme/dark/ page writes that value, including when a themed URL is opened directly. It is not limited to a click on the theme switch. On ordinary routes, a saved value can redirect you to the matching themed URL. The application sets no expiry for this preference. It can remain across browser sessions until replaced, cleared or removed by browser settings. It is read locally for theming; the application does not send the value to an analytics service. This is not a cookie and is not a consent record. Your browser controls The header’s Light and Dark links change the theme. You can clear this site’s stored data in your browser settings or block storage. Clearing site data can remove the preference; revisiting a themed URL with JavaScript enabled writes it again. Without JavaScript, the theme links still navigate to styled static pages and preserve the theme through their URLs, but do not save a new local-storage preference. On an unthemed page without a saved redirect, the design follows your system colour preference. Third parties and launch review Social platforms open only when you follow their links; they are not embedded widgets. Their storage practices are separate. The final host may add behaviour not present in the local preview. Owner / legal review Reinspect the final domain, response headers, cookies and storage. Approve the storage classification, any required notice or consent controls, provider information and effective date against applicable law. No legal exemption or compliance finding is asserted here.
